settings.title: Holding the steering wheel star (☆) key
settings.description: A short press stays what you pick in the car's own star key menu, which also lists "Battery conditioning: start / stop" and "Battery conditioning: open". Takes effect at the next Apply changes.

options.title: Starts conditioning, or stops it if it's running

settings.title: Notices when conditioning starts, times out or ends
settings.description: After a start, watches the car's conditioning indicator for up to 6 minutes and shows the car's own notice when it comes on, or when HMG-API gives up on it.
